name: toolbox
short: Install and manage Node.js/npm on the bot host from Discord.
description: Downloads official Node.js prebuilt releases from nodejs.org into Red's per-cog data directory and puts them on PATH, so a bot owner can install, uninstall, or switch the Node.js/npm version their host uses -- without shell access to the machine. Defaults to the latest Node.js 22.x LTS release, the version pinned across this ecosystem (pixel-index's engines.node, pixel-agents' .nvmrc).
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store any data or metadata about users.
install_msg: Requires corridor (auto-loaded). Bot owner only: `[p]toolbox node install` to install Node.js/npm, `[p]toolbox node uninstall` to remove it, `[p]toolbox node version` to check what's installed.
author: Tin Nguyen
